author_selection: Training demonstrations only, leave-one-out, exact grid accuracy then pixel error; failed controls or runtime errors invalidate weight-dependence evidence. All raw responses and invalid attempts retained.
controls: Program: separately labeled host-inferred/reference and identity baselines. Weights: zero, one position-matched random proposal per attempt (same shapes/ranges), plus two diagnostic random draws; record errors and separate diagnostic budgets. Direct program is a stronger non-weight baseline.

credits.meter: unknown; parent must reserve bounded tranche; no paid API/cloud fallback

held_out_policy: No ARC2 evaluation files. No reserved report IDs d282b262/11dc524f downloaded or read. Existing four-task development panel is spent; not an independent held-out set.
query_evaluation: One frozen selection per arm on own task query, afterwards only; labels never enter candidate process. Independently replay from saved source and literals. Existing search query was previously scored, so result is development evidence.
runtime_requirement: Existing AST sandbox inside authorized Linux runtime with bounded memory, wall kill, clean environment and confirmed network isolation; Windows wall-only fallback is not used.
stop: STOP file or exhausted two attempts per arm; passing all demonstrations freezes that arm immediately. No retry from query outcomes.
